journey.title: My Tech Journey
journey.description: From traditional software engineering to exploring Web3 and AI

2019.title: Entering Software Engineering
2019.description: Studied Software Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology, building systematic knowledge in computer science. From algorithms and data structures to modern frontend technologies, gradually developing a comprehensive understanding of software development.

2021.title: Exploring Data Visualization
2021.description: Interned at ByteDance, focusing on frontend engineering and data visualization. Deepened understanding of React ecosystem and explored how visualization makes complex data intuitive and accessible.

2023.title: Diving into AIGC Wave
2023.description: Founded Wisemind AI to explore the possibilities of AI-generated content. Researched Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI for AI art generation, learned LangChain and AI Agent development, understanding how AIGC reshapes content creation.

2025.title: Embracing Web3 World
2025.description: Joined a licensed cryptocurrency exchange in Hong Kong, combining frontend expertise with blockchain technology. Learning Web3.js, smart contract interactions, and understanding the technical architecture of decentralized finance.

personal.name: Zeta.
personal.intro: I turn odd ideas into small tools and interactive experiments. This is where I keep the things I am building, learning, and figuring out along the way.
personal.nowLead: A few things I've been working on lately. Some are live; some are still rough.
personal.nowText: Small tools for creators, interactive explanations for complicated systems, and experiments that make learning feel more like play.
personal.prompterone: A teleprompter that follows your voice, records with the camera, and can be controlled from another device.
personal.mechanismLab: Interactive lessons that take complicated onchain mechanisms apart and rebuild them as things you can touch.
personal.soundcraft: An electronic-music learning lab with real sound experiments—less collecting tutorials, more making noise.
personal.footerKicker: THE INTERNET IS A SMALL PLACE

collateralizedStablecoin.name: Collateralized Stablecoin Protocol
collateralizedStablecoin.description: A decentralized stablecoin platform where users can mint stablecoins by depositing collateral assets. Experience core DeFi mechanisms including collateralization, redemption, and liquidation triggered by oracle price feeds. Explore the fundamentals of over-collateralized debt positions.

cryptoPlantsVsZombies.name: Crypto Plants vs. Zombies
cryptoPlantsVsZombies.description: A blockchain-based tower defense game inspired by Plants vs. Zombies where players collect and upgrade NFT plants to defend against zombie invasions. Earn tokens through gameplay and trade your NFT plants in the marketplace. Features strategic gameplay, unique NFT characters, and play-to-earn mechanics.
